summary.intent: Wrap up outstanding Callisto v1 stability work (open PRs, cleanup of worktrees/branches), diagnose why Dependabot PR #516 failed, verify a pasted Caliper finding for change #224, and then tackle all remaining planned work items.
summary.outcome: Opened PR #515 (drop undocumented pre-major-inference "false" alias), cleaned up 15 merged agent worktrees and 32 local branches, diagnosed #516's failures, confirmed the Caliper #224 finding on origin/feat/checker-supplies-facts without fixing it, and launched five parallel agents for the remaining work.

repo: Callisto repo is squash-merge only, so `git branch --merged` can't identify merged branches; check PR merge state via `gh pr list --state all --head <branch>` before deleting local branches.

Dependabot bumps of taiki-e/install-action update the four workflow files but skip the composite action `.github/actions/install-workflow-linters/action.yml`, leaving two pinned commits that `verify-action-pins.sh` (Workflow Contracts check) rejects; Dependabot config likely lacks `/.github/actions/`.

Python requirement parse/render is not idempotent: proptest found input `¡[\u{b}[` where first parse yields extras `[]` but re-parsing the rendered form yields `["["]`; regression seed belongs in `crates/callisto-manifests/proptest-regressions/python/tests.txt`.
Invalid pre-major-inference values produce error E256; docs/config.md lists only off, conservative and conservative-feat.
Exit codes freeze at 1.0: unknown `--package` exits 1 (E102) while E227 exits 2; exit classification lives in `exit_kind()` per error type.
Release PR #493 (0.20.0) showed DIRTY (merge conflicts) though recently regenerated; generated branch, expected to be rebuilt by the release workflow after pushes to main.
Caliper change numbers like #224 are Entire trail change numbers, not GitHub PR numbers (Caliper PR #224 is an unrelated CI change).
Local Caliper main was 437 commits behind origin; the `states_bases` code lives on origin/main and origin/feat/checker-supplies-facts.

code.finding: Name-only traversal calls `base_types` only when `states_bases(&info)` is true, otherwise returns an empty Vec. `states_bases` checks OBJECT_CLASS|OBJECT_INTERFACE, so an instantiated generic like `Props<string>` (Reference flag only) is rejected and loses HTMLAttributes from `composes`. Fix: resolve the Reference's generic target and follow it.
Removed the `"false"` arm of pre-major-inference parsing and its test assertion in PR #515.

workflow: Verify audit/review claims against the actual code and correct repo checkout before acting; the first Caliper check failed only because the local checkout was stale.
Before force-removing locked worktrees, run a read-only safety report (uncommitted changes, commits ahead of remote) and confirm PR merged state.
Fetch refs without switching branches to avoid touching the user's working tree.
Split parallel agents by file ownership to avoid conflicts; flag unilateral decisions (e.g. exit-2 call) in the PR for user confirmation.
Session write access limited to Callisto worktrees, so cross-repo fixes (Caliper) need a separate session.

friction: Pasted finding referenced files not in Callisto, and the stale local Caliper main made the code appear missing, costing several rounds.
"Change #224" was ambiguous (GitHub PR vs Entire trail change number).
Four worktrees were locked and required `--force --force` after safety checks.
Entire Gates failure on #516 was not investigated.
Release PR #493 shows merge conflicts that can't be resolved by hand on a generated branch.
Session cannot write to Caliper, blocking the #224 fix.
open_items: Caliper #224 fix on feat/checker-supplies-facts: add a `Props<string>` regression fixture, then resolve generic target for Reference types (check whether RPC already has a target-resolution call); needs a Caliper session.
Confirm the exit-2 decision for bad flag values (made unilaterally by the assistant, flagged in its PR).
Merge #512–#515 and #495, then refresh and re-read release PR #493 (0.20.0) as a user.
Land the Dependabot pin fix and `.github/actions/` config so #516 (and likely #517) can pass.
Fix the Python requirement idempotency bug with a regression seed in a separate PR.
Review results of the five launched agents (pin fix, Python parser, exit 2, errors.md wording, over-engineering audit).
Rewrite stale NEXT-WORK.md from verified state; open decisions: private workspace root listed as package, fixed-group tag and title (E194), OIDC publishing.
Lower-value audit items: errors.md help wording, two workflow-grep scripts, rstest collapse of near-identical tests, `has_*` bools in init.rs.
Delete merged remote branches on origin (#501, #503–#514) or enable GitHub auto-delete on merge.
Four ~/Projects/callisto-fixtures worktrees (wt-cleanup-1/2/3, clean-cleanup) and chore/callisto-* branches left unchecked.
Entire Gates failure on #516 not investigated.
